findings.title: Preserve the `$__range` check before interpolation
findings.body: This interpolates each expression before `querySupportsSplitting` checks it. When `applyTemplateVariables` expands `$__range`, `isQueryWithRangeVariable` can no longer recognize the macro, so a query that the existing guard deliberately keeps unsplit is divided into time chunks. That changes the macro’s intended range semantics and can produce incorrect results. The same eager interpolation in `shardQuerySplitting.ts` also affects the sharded path; retain whether the original expression contained `$__range` when deciding whether to split.
